title: Survey authoring & shared UI foundations
description: Built reusable React and Next.js modules in an Nx monorepo for enterprise survey authoring, with AI assistance for content generation, routing, and validation.
highlights: Reusable React and Next.js components reduced code redundancy by 30%.
OpenAI Assistants API integration for intelligent routing
LangChain agents for automated metadata extraction
Streaming UI responses with dynamic multi-step workflows
Schema-driven form generation with intelligent assistance
focus: Modular architecture / Reusable components / Accessible workflows

caseStudy.problem: Enterprise survey-authoring apps were built with duplicated front-end code, and survey authors needed AI help with content, routing and validation.
caseStudy.role: Led the modular front-end architecture in React, Next.js and TypeScript, and integrated OpenAI and LangChain into the authoring workflow.
decisions: Moved shared UI into an Nx monorepo of reusable React and Next.js components, instead of per-app copies
Built GitHub Actions pipelines for builds, tests, linting and releases across web apps and npm packages
Streamed AI responses into the UI, with tool calls and schema-driven forms
caseStudy.result: 30% less code redundancy, WCAG 2.2 AA-compliant interfaces, and AI-assisted survey authoring in production.

title: Conversational Bot UI Framework
description: Developed reusable conversational and bot-driven UI components supporting streaming responses, tool calls, fallback chains, and dynamic multi-step workflows for enterprise applications.

title: Financial Workflow Automation
description: Modernized RRSP and TFSA workflows in Vue 3 using composable APIs and Pinia, with schema-driven forms, validation, and reliable form session recovery.
highlights: Vue 3 migration for investment and retirement workflows
SQL and NoSQL-backed form data and caching
focus: Vue 3 migration / Form reliability / Automated testing

caseStudy.problem: RRSP and TFSA investment workflows needed to move to Vue 3, and form defects were too frequent.
caseStudy.role: Led the Vue 3 migration and set up the testing frameworks.
decisions: Rebuilt the workflows with Vue 3 composable APIs and Pinia for state
Made the investment and retirement forms schema-driven, with shared validation
Introduced Jest and Karma test frameworks, plus session recovery backed by SQL and NoSQL caching
caseStudy.result: 40% fewer defects across the investment and retirement workflows.

title: Enterprise Dashboard Rebuild
description: Rebuilt enterprise banking dashboards in React and Redux, with multi-step approval flows, API integrations, and PostgreSQL-backed report caching.
highlights: Redux state management for approval workflows
focus: State management / Approval workflows / Report caching

caseStudy.problem: Enterprise banking dashboards and multi-step approval flows needed to be faster to work through.
caseStudy.role: Rebuilt the dashboards and approval flows in React and Redux.
decisions: Managed multi-step approval state in Redux
Wrapped backend APIs in reusable front-end components
Added a PostgreSQL caching layer for reports, backed by structured unit and integration tests
